stories.title: Ken Skates says ALN funding dispute forced Labour to reject budget
stories.summary: New Welsh Labour leader Ken Skates said he regretted that his party could not support the Welsh Government’s supplementary budget that reallocated £344 million of ALN funding elsewhere. stories.title: Vehicle seized and wanted man arrested in Ewloe lorry checks
stories.summary: A man wanted on an extradition warrant was arrested during a joint vehicle safety operation in Ewloe on Tuesday. stories.title: Cabinet minister sets out plan for 20,000 more social homes in Wales by 2030
stories.summary: The Welsh Government has set a target of delivering 20,000 additional social homes by 2030.
